The US State Department has confirmed serving a diplomatic summons to the Indian Embassy over the alleged plot to assassinate Khalistani separatist Gurpatwant Singh Pannun. The case names senior Indian officials, including Ajit Doval. India has rejected the allegations. What does this mean for India-US relations?
